testDesignNotes: Falsifiers boot a test-only stub standalone image (embedded CommonJS server.js written into a throwaway committed git repo with .next/BUILD_ID, standalone/.next/BUILD_ID, server.next-config.json and src/) through the real runHarness: real TCP listener, real ws WebSocket server selecting mekstation.v1, real better-sqlite3 durable file with the production mp_matches/mp_match_events columns. Modes break exactly one guarantee each (wrong-port, wrong-address, two-ready, no-ready, exit-after-ready, log-token, echo-token, no-public, reject-actions, spectator-acts, drop-live, close-on-join). The stub is never product proof.

CF-SMOKE-1 rows drive the frozen callbacks: stop (owned pid dead, port free, double stop refused), prepareOffline (refused while running; real fixtures.ts via tsx lineage on the stopped DB; the fixture itself refuses a live owning pid), restart (new pid, same port, re-verified image; a changed server.js is refused) and reconnect (replay after restart still carries every baseline public event id).
Credential rows wrap the redactor to capture every raw credential the run issued and scan every retained file and the thrown error for them, on success and failure paths.
Cleanup rows assert every owned pid from summary.json is dead and its port free, and that an unrelated bystander process survives a failing run.
gitignore: scripts/** is ignored by .gitignore:38 with a whitelist; scripts/release is not whitelisted, so the leaf is added with git add -f, the established convention (606 tracked files under scripts are ignored-but-tracked). Consequence: directory-walk linting (lint-units 'scripts', which honours .gitignore) does not visit the four leaves, so the 50/50 scripts ceiling is unaffected either way; the leaves are linted by explicit path (oxlint --config scripts/qc/oxlint-units.json --allow no-console <file>) and must report 0 warnings / 0 errors. No .gitignore edit (outside the manifest).
